title: How a Godly Man Treats the Task Too Small to Matter
caption:
A godly man works the same whether anyone's grading it.

The task nobody sees is the one that tells the truth about him.

Finish what won't make the highlight reel. Work like God's the only audience. Let the small job rehearse the big one. Refuse the reward you can't see yet.

Excellent and unseen is still excellent.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #workethic #discipline #becomewhoyouweremade
